messages:
Ilya: FYI we're kicking off a light least-privilege sweep next week focused on infra/payments admin roles + KMS grants. Objective: surface >90d inactive console/KMS access, flag roles with high cardinality (>6 members), and correlate with audit logs before any change. Dry-run first.
Monica: +1. Please add an `owner_hint` column (email or team) and a `last_audit_event` timestamp so teams can see recent auth/log activity.
Carlos: Exclude `oncall` and `emergency_access` roles. Also add a filter for `requires-manual=true` tags.
Hannah: For KMS, capture cross-account grants and anything with `ExternalPrincipal`. I can map to key policies. Small ask: include a column for "auth_flow" (UI/API) if available.
Ilya: Plan: dry-run -> CSV -> owner ping (slack + email) -> 72h attestation window -> soft-disable label -> 48h rollback window. Notify Product Security for any ExternalPrincipal.
SREBot: dry-run scheduled by Ilya for 2026-06-02T10:00Z. Will post artifacts here.
Carlos: Quick query I run: 
```sql
SELECT r.name AS role, p.principal, max(a.ts) AS last_auth
FROM rbac_bindings r
LEFT JOIN auth_events a ON a.principal = r.principal
WHERE r.name ILIKE 'admin_%'
GROUP BY r.name, p.principal
HAVING max(a.ts) < now() - interval '90 days';
```
Ilya: KMS snippet (AWS) Carlos suggested for cross-account: 
```bash
aws kms list-grants --key-id $KEY --query "Grants[?CreateTime<\`$(date -d '90 days ago' --iso-8601=seconds)\`]"
```
EntBot: Dry-run complete: 47 bindings flagged, 13 aged KMS grants, 8 roles >6 members, 10 principals with ExternalPrincipal. CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/leastpriv/4999991234.csv
Monica: I'll triage the top payments and cross-account ones. Hannah to map key owners. Carlos to add the `requires-manual` exclusion.
Hannah: Mapping keys -> owners now. Any KMS grants lacking an owner will be escalated to Product Security.
Carlos: Adding `exclude:oncall=true` and `requires-manual` to the script; will post a PR.
Ilya: Action items: Monica triage, Hannah KMS mapping, Carlos update script, SREBot run soft-disable (dry-run toggle) after attestation window. We'll keep changes reversible and limited to soft-disables.
Monica: One more: let's correlate flagged bindings with recent vuln triage tickets (if a principal was involved in an incident). Helps decide immediate revocation. I can join that lookup.
Ilya: Good point. Add a column `recent_incident_refs` from the incident tracker. If present, escalate to the incident response owner before disabling.
EntBot: Noted. Owner pings will include a one-click attestation link and clear rollback steps.
Ilya: Thanks team. Aim to start remediation 2026-06-05 after notice window. Keep this chat as the source of truth for any rollbacks or unexpected breakage.
Hannah: I'll post the owner mapping and a short checklist for re-enabling KMS grants if we need rollback.
Carlos: PR incoming for script changes and exclusion tests.
Monica: I'll post a short summary to #product-security once top 10 triage items are identified.
Ilya: Perfect. Low blast, reversible, and traceable. Ping me if anything risky shows up before the run. :wave:
